theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest durability (0.76) among eligible top-ranked themes with strong breadth (0.90) and trend-tagged hurst, and it passes the absolute-trend gate — the one validated risk-control leg. Momentum rank (3rd) supports attention concentration; the crowded flag (z=1.82) is a size-down caution, not a fade. Trend-following, gate-eligible leadership with intact breadth argues for a lean toward continued persistence.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.82 is the highest crowding flag in the eligible set; thematic-ETF inflows and attention spikes often mark tops rather than continuation, and the momentum rank carries no validated forward edge.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its 20-day rolling low before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Strongest durability (0.85) in the entire eligible universe, trend-tagged, excellent breadth (0.917), and uncrowded (z=0.69). Passes the absolute-trend gate. Even though rank is 5th, the staying-power leg (durability + trend gate) is the most validated signal available; high persistence probability supports a lean.
theses.dissent: Multiple semiconductor sub-themes (Memory, AI Infra, AI Semis, WFE, Non-AI Tech) all map to SMH, so single-name concentration within SMH may dominate; also memory is the leader, not AI semis, and the momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: AI Semiconductors basket lags the S&P 500 by over 5% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Moderate durability (0.67), strong breadth (0.917), uncrowded (z=-0.06), and gate-eligible. The macro backdrop shows a high unscheduled-surprise share (1.0) with geopolitics prominent in recent macro narrative flow, consistent with the defensive/real-asset tone. Trend-tagged breadth supports persistence; uncrowded status means no reflexivity cap risk.
evidence: crowding_z -0.06 (least crowded in top decile of eligible)
theses.dissent: Momentum rank is 7th, lower than many tech themes, and 'mixed' hurst tag points to no strong trend persistence; gold miners are volatile and can lag both gold itself and the broad market if macro uncertainty resolves quickly.

falsifier.text: GDX gains under 3% while the S&P 500 gains over 2% before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
